directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Could you help me settle this quarrel I have with the Duty guys? I'm not too keen on confronting them right about now.
entries.JA_current: Could you help me settle this quarrel I have with the Duty guys? I'm not too keen on confronting them right about now.
entries.JA_new: デューティーの連中と揉めててさ。仲裁してくれないか？ 今はあいつらとやり合う気になれないんだ。

entries.EN: Damn, you sure know how to pick your enemies, don't you? I'm surprised no one blew you away yet! Alright, wait a moment, I'll check out what harm you have inflicted and find out the bounty on your head. This will influence the price, mind you, but I'm sure you already knew that... That'll be on top of what I'll charge you for my trouble.
entries.JA_current: Damn, you sure know how to pick your enemies, don't you? I'm surprised no one blew you away yet! Alright, wait a moment, I'll check out what harm you have inflicted and find out the bounty on your head. This will influence the price, mind you, but I'm sure you already knew that... That'll be on top of what I'll charge you for my trouble.
entries.JA_new: まったく、敵を選ぶ目があるな。まだ誰にも撃ち殺されてないのが不思議なくらいだ。よし、待ってろ。お前が連中に何をしたか調べて、首にかかった懸賞金も聞いてくる。それで料金が変わるからな。もちろん、俺の手間賃は別だ。……わかってるだろ？

entries.EN: Well, it's not as bad as I thought, you didn't cause that much trouble and they're willing to look the other way if I front them the bounty. I can clear your name right here, right now for 10 grand. What do you say?
entries.JA_current: Well, it's not as bad as I thought, you didn't cause that much trouble and they're willing to look the other way if I front them the bounty. I can clear your name right here, right now for 10 grand. What do you say?
entries.JA_new: 思ったほどひどくないな。お前も大した迷惑はかけてない。懸賞金を俺が立て替えれば、連中も見逃してくれるそうだ。今ここで1万ルーブル払えば、名前をきれいにしてやる。どうする？

entries.EN: Whoops... You've vexed them quite a lot, you're a regular troublemaker, aren't you... They won't accept the bounty so I offered to consider it a personal favor down the line. For this reason, I'm gonna tax you heavily. Fork over 30 grand and you can consider them pacified, for now...
entries.JA_current: Whoops... You've vexed them quite a lot, you're a regular troublemaker, aren't you... They won't accept the bounty so I offered to consider it a personal favor down the line. For this reason, I'm gonna tax you heavily. Fork over 30 grand and you can consider them pacified, for now...
entries.JA_new: おっと……相当怒らせたみたいだな。よほどのトラブルメーカーらしい。懸賞金じゃ受け取らないそうだ。代わりに、いずれ個人的な頼みを聞くって約束しておいた。だから高くつくぞ。3万ルーブル出せば、ひとまず怒りを収めてくれる。どうする？

entries.EN: Holy hell, you've really kicked the hornets nest out there, haven't heard my guy swear and mouth off like that in a long time, not since Freedom claimed one of their fancy exo-skeleton shipments! It's almost as if you went out of the Zone and wasted all their families in the Big Land, then nailed their mutilated heads in front of their HQ, they really want you! In fact, they're cooking up something nasty for you, apparently they're planning to catch you and have you roasted alive in front of the boys. Wouldn't want to be in your shoes, fella! Your problems are hard to solve, but... Nothing is impossible, I'll try to bribe the lead guy over there but he's gonna want a fat bounty as restitution for the harm you caused. I'm gonna need 80 grand to fix your mess, take it or leave it!

Your problems are hard to solve, but... Nothing is impossible, I'll try to bribe the lead guy over there but he's gonna want a fat bounty as restitution for the harm you caused. I'm gonna need 80 grand to fix your mess, take it or leave it!
entries.JA_new: なんてこった、あっちでスズメバチの巣をつついたどころじゃないな。あいつがあんなに怒鳴って罵るのを聞いたのは久しぶりだ。フリーダムがデューティーの高級エクソスケルトン輸送隊を奪った時以来だな！ ゾーンの外に出て、連中の家族を皆殺しにして、切り刻んだ頭を本部の前に並べたってくらい恨まれてるぞ！ 捕まえて仲間の前で生きたまま焼くつもりらしい。お前の立場にはなりたくないね。厄介な問題だが……まあ、無理じゃない。向こうの隊長に賄賂を渡してみる。ただ、お前がやったことの埋め合わせに、かなりの金を要求してる。8万ルーブルで片をつけてやる。乗るか？

entries.EN: Fine, I fucked up, now I've got to pay my dues, I guess...
entries.JA_current: Fine, I fucked up, now I've got to pay my dues, I guess...
entries.JA_new: わかったよ。俺が悪かったんだ、ケジメはつけないとな……

entries.EN: To hell with Duty. I'll handle it myself somehow.
entries.JA_current: To hell with Duty. I'll handle it myself somehow.
entries.JA_new: デューティーなんか知るか。何とか自分で片づける。
